title: Henry Morris
gist: Prospect Magazine author index page for Henry Morris, a satirist and rave promoter who ran the Secret Tory Twitter account from 2019 to 2023, listing five 'Embedded with' political reportage pieces on Reform and Starmer. No article body — signal is limited to the bio and the headline set.

insights.claim: Henry Morris ran the Secret Tory Twitter account between 2019 and 2023, fooling the country into believing he was a Conservative MP, and now writes embedded political reportage for Prospect.
insights.so_what: A four-year successful impersonation of an MP on a major platform is a concrete precedent for how cheaply political credibility can be counterfeited online.
insights.quote: Between 2019 and 2023, he fooled the country into believing he was a Conservative MP on the Secret Tory Twitter account.
insights.locator: Henry Morris is a satirist and rave promoter
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: His five listed Prospect pieces are almost entirely embedded coverage of Reform — Clacton, Wales campaign trail, a think tank, Hadrian's Wall — with a single Starmer piece, showing where the magazine directed its on-the-ground political attention.
insights.so_what: Sustained embedded coverage of Reform signals mainstream UK press treating it as a governing-relevant force, not a fringe protest vote.
insights.locator: Politics / Embedded with Reform: Finding Farage, in Clacton of all places
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: The Starmer piece is headlined 'After me, the resignation', indicating the column was covering the end of the Starmer premiership rather than its campaign phase.
insights.so_what: Dates the coverage to a UK leadership transition, useful context for reading Prospect's contemporaneous political commentary.
insights.quote: Embedded with Starmer: After me, the resignation
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
